content:

SDキャラ、1枚絵、立ち絵どのデザインでも構いませんので描いてみたいという方がいましたらリプにてご連絡お待ちしております！！

author: A Ftelina graphic
title: Hiring Character Artist for Dimension 11 Studios game
content:
WE'RE HIRING: CHARACTER ARTIST!
🎨

We're looking for a talented and creative Character Artist to join Dimension 11 Studios as we continue developing Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water, a narrative-driven action-adventure game rooted in African history and mythology.

We're looking for someone with strong 3D character modelling and texturing skills, experience with Unreal Engine and MetaHuman, and a great eye for detail.
Experience creating African hairstyles, realistic 4C hair, and detailed character materials is particularly important for this role.

If you have a strong character art portfolio and the skills to bring compelling characters to life, we'd love to hear from you!

Job Mode: Remote
Collaboration: Long-term, ongoing

Interested?
Find the full job description and application details here: https://t.co/mK03P2PY1P
